text:
maria: Heads-up — planning a narrow flip tomorrow 03:00–04:00 UTC: set enable_predictive_batching=true for tenant group beta-2. Who can own the flip + smoke? Need rollback readiness.

ashok: I can take it. Quick Q: are we enabling fallback_to_sync safe-default?

maria: yes — we'll set fallback_to_sync=true and batch_size_cap=64 by default. also set max_concurrency=8 per-tenant.

sophie: pinging infra — any infra changes required? If not, I can run smoke.

ashok: infra OK, no infra changes. smoke checklist (quick):
- verify toggle applied via `/feature-toggle list tenant:beta-2`
- run ~20 sample requests against canary endpoint
- check p50/p95 latency and token throughput in the live dashboard
- confirm error-rate delta < 0.5%

maria: deploy-bot scheduled window 03:05 UTC. Command we'll run: 
```
/feature-toggle set enable_predictive_batching true --scope=tenant:beta-2 --until=2026-03-18T04:00Z --meta fallback_to_sync=true
```

deploy-bot: scheduled by @maria for 2026-03-18T03:05:00Z — reminder set :bell:

sophie: I'll run smoke at +5 and +20 minutes. If anything abnormal, rollback plan: 
1) `/feature-toggle set enable_predictive_batching false --scope=tenant:beta-2`
2) disable batcher at runtime `rbctl set batcher.disable tenant:beta-2 true`
3) escalate to @eng-oncall and post in #eng-sre

ashok: noted. I will be online from 02:50–04:30 UTC. tagging @maria to confirm final scope and keys.

maria: confirmed. leaving safe-defaults and canary capacity as above. I'll post final go/no-go at 02:45 UTC. :thumbsup:

sophie: thanks — will report back once smoke done. :white_check_mark:
